svg.text: Layers stack into one prompt; a live session gets it pasted, an exited one is resumed by role; optional, project-side: add rules before edits.

g.text: Base workflow → public lessons → project lessons → project additions, joined end to end.

text.font-family: system-ui, 'PingFang SC', 'Noto Sans CJK SC', sans-serif

g.text: Each layer is more specific than the last; on conflict the last one, project additions, wins.

text.font-family: Georgia, 'Noto Serif CJK SC', 'Songti SC', serif
system-ui, 'PingFang SC', 'Noto Sans CJK SC', sans-serif

g.text: Fill in this issue / PR's number, branch and working directory,

text.font-family: system-ui, 'PingFang SC', 'Noto Sans CJK SC', sans-serif

g.text: and that is everything the worker gets this round. Comment text is data, never instructions.

text.font-family: Georgia, 'Noto Serif CJK SC', 'Songti SC', serif
system-ui, 'PingFang SC', 'Noto Sans CJK SC', sans-serif

g.text: If this number's tmux session is still up, the whole prompt is pasted in and Enter submits it.

text.font-family: system-ui, 'PingFang SC', 'Noto Sans CJK SC', sans-serif

g.text: The model keeps its conversation and remembers what it already did.

text.font-family: Georgia, 'Noto Serif CJK SC', 'Songti SC', serif
system-ui, 'PingFang SC', 'Noto Sans CJK SC', sans-serif

g.text: The conversation recorded for number + role is resumed; only if there is none does a new one start.

text.font-family: system-ui, 'PingFang SC', 'Noto Sans CJK SC', sans-serif

g.text: Coding and review keep separate records, so a review never resumes the coding conversation.

text.font-family: Georgia, 'Noto Serif CJK SC', 'Songti SC', serif

g.text: 5 Project-side hook (example, not part of cavil-loop): find rule files

text.font-family: system-ui, 'PingFang SC', 'Noto Sans CJK SC', sans-serif

g.text: Before the worker edits a file with Edit / Write, the hook walks up from that file's directory for AGENTS.md,

text.font-family: system-ui, 'PingFang SC', 'Noto Sans CJK SC', sans-serif

g.text: picking only those not yet sent this session. Edits via Bash do not trigger it; nor does codex review.

text.font-family: Georgia, 'Noto Serif CJK SC', 'Songti SC', serif

g.text: 6 Project-side hook (example): inject before the edit

text.font-family: system-ui, 'PingFang SC', 'Noto Sans CJK SC', sans-serif

g.text: The rule files found reach the model before this edit runs, not a round later.

text.font-family: system-ui, 'PingFang SC', 'Noto Sans CJK SC', sans-serif

g.text: Files already sent in this session are not repeated, so the context does not balloon.
